LNG export marine terminal (2 x 225,000 m3, 2 berths, 28 MTPA)

T-2101: full containment, 225,000 m3 working, Phase 1, as built (D-007). In-tank pumps hang in their pump columns with foot valves; every nozzle passes through the roof (drawn on the shell for clarity, D-021).
Minimum-flow returns FV-2111A..D: LNG-2021..2024 DN 150; FV-2112: LNG-2025 DN 100.
Column isolation HV-2151A..D, HV-2152 above the check valves; column vent / N2 purge BOG-2011..2015 DN 25 with HV-2161..2165 (blind-flanged, to atmosphere at the roof).
CV-2121A..D, CV-2122: disc with a pressure-equalising hole, relieving the CV/HV spool to the pump column (thermal relief; vendor, D-021).
Thermal relief to T-2101 (roof nozzles), set 15.0 barg: PSV-2141 on LNG-2001 via LNG-2031, PSV-2142 on LNG-2002 via LNG-2032, DN 25.
PSV-2131A..C (0.29 barg) and vacuum relief PSV-2133A..C (-0.3 kPa(g)): N+1, interlocked locked-open inlet isolation (vendor).
LZT-2102: see C&E I-201, I-202. LZT-2106: independent high-high, 1oo2 with LZT-2102 (C&E I-201). PZT-2112: see C&E I-203, I-204.
pnb plants & bytes GmbH, Aachen, Germany
